name: Zion
source:
I reckon that when merchants and common folk talk about the terror the Raiders represent, they must have someone like Zion in mind, a muscle-bound fury with a mean streak.

She clearly has seen some shit. Asha tells me she almost never takes off her mask and... well, she manages to keep up with the toughest of raiders despite having only one arm left to fight with.
